result.summary: The page appears largely well-rendered. Only one notable visual defect was found: the profile avatar in the top-right corner shows an empty placeholder instead of an image or fallback initials. Carousel edge clipping and the partially visible bottom card were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The profile avatar circle in the top-right corner is an empty gray placeholder with a notification dot but no avatar image, initials, or icon inside it.
issues.suggestion: Display the user's profile photo, or a fallback such as the user's initials or a generic person icon, inside the avatar circle so it doesn't look like a broken/unloaded image.
